summary: Workgraph-v2 cumulative structural/causal challenge for the newest COMPLETE machine cycle. Downstream backlog remains above capacity (24 legacy ready_for_chief), so no ordinary expansion was opened. Existing b03 causal mappings remain decision-useful and no new machine-state fact in this cycle falsifies them; underwriting gates remain separate.

claims: AI compute and memory complexity can increase semiconductor test intensity, creating a test-equipment bottleneck exposure.
causalEdges: AI compute -> logic/memory complexity -> test intensity -> TER
risks: automation/robotics weakness can offset semiconductor-test strength
contradictions: AI demand strength does not guarantee TER-specific capture
companies.falsifier: AI/memory units grow without TER test demand

claims: Labor/productivity pressure supports automation demand through controls and software integration.
causalEdges: labor/productivity pressure -> automation -> control/software integration -> ROK
contradictions: secular automation can coexist with cyclical order weakness
companies.falsifier: automation spending grows while ROK organic demand decouples

claims: Last-mile labor/cost pressure creates a potential autonomous-delivery bottleneck opportunity, but scale must convert to positive fleet economics.
causalEdges: last-mile labor/cost -> autonomous delivery -> fleet density/economics -> SERV
contradictions: deployment growth is not evidence of self-funding economics
companies.falsifier: deployment scale rises without path to positive gross economics

claims: Freight labor/utilization pressure can support autonomous trucking if certification, network access and commercial utilization convert into economics.
causalEdges: freight labor/utilization -> autonomous trucking -> certification/network scale -> AUR
contradictions: technical milestones do not establish commercial economics
companies.falsifier: technical milestones advance but commercial miles/revenue fail after access

claims: Electrification and data-center load increase grid/distribution constraints, supporting equipment-capacity exposure.
causalEdges: electrification/data-center load -> grid distribution constraint -> equipment capacity -> ETN
contradictions: secular demand does not remove balance-sheet execution risk
companies.falsifier: infrastructure spending expands while ETN electrical backlog contracts

claims: Grid/data-center buildout can shift the bottleneck to engineering/construction capacity and execution.
causalEdges: grid/data-center buildout -> engineering/construction capacity -> execution -> PWR
contradictions: backlog is not guaranteed cash conversion
companies.falsifier: commitments stay high while RPO conversion/awards weaken

claims: Industrial/data-center power demand can create switchgear and control bottlenecks.
causalEdges: data-center/industrial power -> distribution bottleneck -> switchgear/control -> POWL
contradictions: large orders increase concentration as well as opportunity
companies.falsifier: electrical demand expands while POWL backlog/order conversion deteriorates

claims: Firm-power demand plus interconnection scarcity can increase value of available generation fleets.
causalEdges: firm-power demand -> generation scarcity/interconnection -> fleet availability -> CEG
companies.falsifier: scarcity persists while contracted fleet economics/utilization weaken

claims: Load growth and dispatchable scarcity can support integrated generation/retail economics.
causalEdges: load growth -> dispatchable scarcity -> fleet/retail integration -> VST
contradictions: hedging reduces volatility but does not remove merchant economics
companies.falsifier: load/scarcity rises while normalized fleet cash generation deteriorates

claims: Data-center power constraints can increase demand for onsite resilient generation.
causalEdges: data-center power constraint -> onsite resilient generation -> fuel-cell deployment -> BE
contradictions: power scarcity does not guarantee profitable capture
companies.falsifier: power scarcity persists while BE growth/margins fail

claims: Firm clean-power demand can create nuclear-development opportunity, but licensing/framework progress must convert into financed binding projects.
causalEdges: firm clean-power demand -> nuclear licensing/development -> SMR commercialization -> NuScale
companies.falsifier: licensing/framework progress fails to convert into binding financed projects

claims: Warehouse labor/productivity pressure supports automation, while prior insider-form anomaly has been resolved as non-market trust/gift activity.
